lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Stock\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

7 inline scripts in templates/. The Content Security Policy of the server runs neither a <script> without a source or the nonce of the response nor an event handler attribute, so the browser does not run them. A script added with OCP\Util::addScript() or addInitScript() runs.

Nothing in the app calls 5 routes outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates, in 39 files of the frontend source and in the navigation of info.xml. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).

5 inline styles in templates/. The default Content Security Policy of the server allows inline style; a response whose policy disallows it drops them. A stylesheet added with OCP\Util::addStyle() holds in both cases.
